schema.text: How would increased driving-related costs (fuel, tolls, parking) affect your car usage?

options.text: Would stop using car for most trips

en.#How would increased driving-related cos: How would increased driving-related costs (fuel, tolls, parking) affect your car usage?
en.#Would stop using car for most trips: Would stop using car for most trips

it.#How would increased driving-related cos: In che modo un aumento dei costi legati all'uso dell'auto (carburante, pedaggi, parcheggio) influenzerebbe il tuo utilizzo dell'auto?
it.#Would stop using car for most trips: Smetterei di utilizzare l'auto per la maggior parte degli spostamenti

fr.#How would increased driving-related cos: Si les coûts liés à la conduite augmentaient, par exemple le carburant, les péages ou le stationnement, quel effet cela aurait-il sur votre usage de la voiture ?
fr.#Slight reduction in car use: Une légère réduction de mon usage de la voiture
fr.#Moderate reduction in car use: Une réduction modérée de mon usage de la voiture
fr.#Significant reduction in car use: Une forte réduction de mon usage de la voiture
fr.#Would stop using car for most trips: J’arrêterais d’utiliser la voiture pour la plupart de mes déplacements

de.#How would increased driving-related cos: Wenn die Kosten des Autofahrens steigen würden, zum Beispiel Kraftstoff, Maut oder Parken: Wie würde sich das auf Ihre Autonutzung auswirken?
de.#Slight reduction in car use: Ich würde das Auto etwas weniger nutzen
de.#Moderate reduction in car use: Ich würde das Auto deutlich weniger nutzen
de.#Significant reduction in car use: Ich würde das Auto viel weniger nutzen
de.#Would stop using car for most trips: Ich würde für die meisten Wege auf das Auto verzichten

tr.#How would increased driving-related cos: Yakıt, geçiş ücreti veya otopark gibi otomobil kullanma maliyetleri artsaydı otomobil kullanımınız nasıl etkilenirdi?
tr.#Moderate reduction in car use: Otomobili orta düzeyde daha az kullanırdım
tr.#Significant reduction in car use: Otomobili belirgin şekilde daha az kullanırdım

fa.#How would increased driving-related cos: اگر هزینه‌های رانندگی مثل سوخت، عوارض یا پارکینگ افزایش پیدا کند، استفاده شما از خودرو چگونه تغییر می‌کند؟
fa.#Slight reduction in car use: کمی کمتر از خودرو استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#Moderate reduction in car use: تا حد متوسط کمتر از خودرو استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#Significant reduction in car use: به‌طور قابل توجهی کمتر از خودرو استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#Would stop using car for most trips: برای بیشتر سفرها استفاده از خودرو را کنار می‌گذارم

hu.#How would increased driving-related cos: Ha nőnének az autózással kapcsolatos költségek, például az üzemanyag, útdíj vagy parkolás, hogyan változna az autóhasználata?
hu.#Would stop using car for most trips: A legtöbb útra nem használnék autót

ar.#How would increased driving-related cos: إذا ارتفعت تكاليف القيادة مثل الوقود أو الرسوم أو مواقف السيارات، كيف سيؤثر ذلك في استخدامك للسيارة؟
ar.#Would stop using car for most trips: سأتوقف عن استخدام السيارة في معظم الرحلات
